outcomes.question: Colts vs. Steelers: 2Q O/U 10.5

raw_market.question: Colts vs. Steelers: 2Q O/U 10.5
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the NFL game between Colts and Steelers, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Colts and Steelers combine to score 11 or more points in the second quarter.

If the combined second quarter total is less than 11, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
